Market today: The gap between big tech and the rest of the market just vanished. This is the real driver for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are SELL signals and leveraged, which amplifies your margin pain. QQQI (-5.97%) and QQQ (-3.73%) are also SELL/TRIM signals.

Watch: The tech sector's performance relative to the broader market. Also, keep an eye on oil prices as Middle East tensions ease.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech positions are under pressure; focus on managing risk there.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the SELL status and significant loss.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is a SELL signal; evaluate reducing exposure.
QQQI: With a SELL status and negative PnL, consider trimming this income anchor.
